title: Speedy Tofu Singapore Noodles
subtitle: with Capsicum and Peanuts
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Thinly slice the capsicum. Thinly slice the spring onion on an angle, keeping the white and green parts separate. Coarsely chop the peanuts. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Meanwhile, combine the garlic, 2 tsp curry powder and a drizzle of vegetable oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cut the tofu into cubes (see Kitchen 101), add to the marinade and toss to coat.

Stir-fry tofu: Heat a medium deep frypan over high heat until very hot. Stir-fry the tofu for 1 min or until browned. Remove from the pan. Heat a drizzle of vegetable oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the capsicum, stirring, for 2-3 mins until tender.

Add noodles: Add the white part of the spring onion, 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tbs soy sauce and 1 tsp honey to the capsicum and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Add the tofu, noodles and 1½ tbs water and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined and warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the tofu noodles among bowls, scatter over the peanuts and remaining spring onion and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: For an easier clean-up, cut open the tofu packet and slice the tofu into cubes while still inside the packet. This will help stop the tofu marinade from getting onto your chopping board.
